# About the Author {.unnumbered}

**Moody Amakobe** is a multidisciplinary researcher, data scientist, blockchain architect, educator, and technical textbook author. His expertise spans artificial intelligence, computational systems, data engineering, and complex distributed architectures. These areas connect the study of computational methods with the practical work of designing technology systems for real-world use.

He is the founder of the **Global Data Science Institute (GDSI)**, where he leads work across data science, deep learning, algorithm design, and technology-for-impact initiatives. His focus includes efficient algorithms, real-world AI systems, and scalable technologies that address societal challenges. This combination of interests connects the computational foundations of a system with questions about how it can be used in practice.

Amakobe has taught at multiple universities, advised research teams, supervised graduate projects, and authored technology textbooks. His work in education and research sits alongside experience building industry solutions used in healthcare, finance, agriculture, and public systems. Together, these activities span the classroom, research supervision, technical writing, and the development of systems for use beyond an academic setting.

The subjects of *Generative AI* reflect this intersection of research, education, and engineering. The book connects foundational concepts with system design, evaluation, and responsible deployment, giving readers a setting in which to examine technical choices and their consequences. It is published by Global Data Science Institute as an open educational resource for students, educators, and technical practitioners.
